title: Crew of Wellington W5444
memorial_details:
description: Large, square tablet mounted horizontally on a low brick plinth.  The memorial appears to have a thin, white composite board attached to a concrete slab.  The dedication is printed in black, upper and lower-case letters.  An illustrated information board is positioned behind the memorial and a flagpole to the left flies a Union Jack.

Another memorial to this crew is located at All Saint's Church in the same village (ref 19954)
